title: IMUMIA2026
description: A public five-subject sample of a 244-participant motor imagery EEG dataset recorded at Inner Mongolia University. Healthy participants performed cued left/right motor imagery of ten classes covering the hand, foot, thumb, index finger and index-thumb pinch. Each task was recorded under a Classic Arrow paradigm and a Cue-Execution dual-stage paradigm. Data were acquired with a 64-channel Neuroscan system at 1000 Hz and are formatted for use with MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuroscan SynAmps amplifier and a 64-channel Quik-Cap (Ag/AgCl passive electrodes) at 1000 Hz, referenced to Cz with a forehead ground. Impedances were kept below 10 kOhm. Auxiliary EOG (HEO, VEO), EMG and ECG channels were recorded. Each subject completed one session of five runs, one motor-imagery task per run, with visual arrow cues and 4 s imagery intervals. The data are raw and unpreprocessed.
